scope: static, AI-assisted, nothing executed; read C++ host code (color resolve pass, shim, replay changes) and extracted the embedded SPIR-V arrays and validated and disassembled them with spirv-val and spirv-dis; tripwire, overlap and apply-vs-main triage used
findings: Adds D3D12 color MIN/MAX resolve via a Vulkan fragment pass: new GLSL sources, precompiled SPIR-V arrays in color_resolve_spv.h, a ColorResolvePass in vulkan_color_resolve.h, shim and replay wiring, docs and tests.

The four embedded SPIR-V binaries pass spirv-val and use only Shader capability and GLSL.std.450 (texelFetch, min/max, one output store); same pattern as the repo's other *_spv.h files. I did not rebuild them from the .frag/.vert sources to confirm they match.
Vulkan host code checks every create call and frees resources in a destructor. Large PR (+730 lines, 12 files) touching vulkan_replay.h; no overlaps, applies cleanly.
